scope: 20 exact historical keys outside other assignments; full old operator and endpoint meaning/stance inspected and compared with source component review.

rows.review_disposition: 33CF can internalize full restoration versus limited constitutional/electoral monarchy. 1DB77 supplies only the historically invoked 1789 programme, not a general synonym for every later restoration position; preserve that restricted binding.

F6ED must retain official mandate demonetization followed by specie scarcity, falling prices, heavier real debt and barter. 5193 provides the preceding experiment, but the immediate endpoint belongs to the mandates, not the earlier burning of assignat plates.

The reverse contrast is retained inside 33CF with different programmes and contingent appeal explicit. Do not conflate the princes’ programme, the Royal Session’s concessions and the later constitutional alternative.

56435 can internalize propertied opposition qualifying the Directory’s claimed social base. Preserve uncertainty over royalism and the government’s hope to regain substantial citizens, not an abstract social-base node.
2E013 can internalize Fructidor ending the moderate negotiating opportunity through harder terms. Keep British willingness, French political change and actual colonial demands explicit.

B888 must retain Philanthropic Institutes as a practical electoral organization aiding the turn from force to votes. The unresolved strategy label can retire while the organizational mechanism survives.

809CB preserves the Royal Session as the first concrete reversal attempt in the source’s historical definition. Retain the direction and 297–298 scope, without making all later resistance its direct consequence.
4F5D must retain Condé’s survival after the princely collapse through imperial service. 7593 supplies the general collapse; Louis XVIII’s later claim cannot substitute for this military exception.

5398/677352 can retain Mallet within pragmatic constitutional royalism, with his right-wing position and respect for irreversible gains. Retire a broad membership edge without presenting all constitutional exiles as one doctrine.

B319 must retain the Agency for Direct Contributions, commissioners, old personnel/practice and coercive collection as mechanisms of restored fiscal capacity. An abstract reconstruction node is unnecessary.

CB77 can internalize two-stage elections with broad primary taxpayer participation and a much smaller property-qualified electoral college. Preserve the institutional distinction and its normative justification.

29CD can internalize neo-Jacobin electoral success prompting Floréal. Keep prior official manipulation, actual returns and subsequent purge distinct; electoral victory did not establish a unified insurrectionary bloc.

71A8 must retain Sonthonax’s unauthorized local emancipation and military necessity forcing metropolitan ratification. 571CE’s free-coloured-rights-before-abolition sequence is not equivalent to his agency, and 2AC must not absorb the enslaved population’s emancipation.

E268 can internalize limited Catholic relief versus later United Irish radicalization. The 212 relief passage alone cannot evidence the whole later underground and invasion sequence; retain appropriate later source treatments.

C4FA/43E040 must retain concrete British supplies, agents and planning for western linkage with delays and self-interest. Retire the broad supports edge only with the actual assistance and failed contact explicit.

Correct enabled_by direction: Pitt’s willingness and circumstances enabled Lille’s opening, not the talks enabling his entire earlier wartime policy. Preserve the limited negotiation facet within 2E013.

Reject a blanket violent-inner-circle relation to all pures and constitutional exiles. The specific organization belongs to B888’s Institutes/agents/plot distinction; 677352’s ideological categories are not the same organizational hierarchy.

0848 can internalize the Concordat’s institutional restructuring and retrospective Church transformation on 398/424. Preserve poorer salaried clergy, stronger papal authority and state dependence rather than an unbound Church node.

9EDD/BBD must explicitly retain the distinction between anti-Paris or anti-radical resistance and affirmative royalist restoration. A broad contrast edge can retire with this interpretive boundary and federalist republican aims accessible.

79F and 15DCF preserve religion contributing to Vendéan and Breton resistance, with different organizations and local causes. Do not treat an old Vendée endpoint as automatic evidence for all chouannerie; retain each edge’s separate source scope and multi-causal qualification.
